evidence: SetupKeyboard sets DIK_ESCAPE (0x01) for both keyboards; ReadKeyboardDevice gives it bit 0x400, which InRaceMenu_IsBackPressed tests on keyboards.
InitializeForceFeedbackDevice sets it once the device is set up; every effect call returns without it; ResetForceFeedbackEffectsAlt clears it.
Pad page item 1 (text 0x7b "Texture Forces") through Input_Get/SetControllerPrimaryFlags; StageTiming_InitForceFeedbackSlots copies it into the slot that scales the steering force.
Pad page item 0 (text 0x7a "Effects Forces") through Input_Get/SetControllerSecondaryFlags; the slot copy scales the spring and damper coefficients.

Pad page item 2 (text 0x1a8 "Quick Force Update", On = 1); copied per device by SetForceFeedbackDeviceValue, without it SetEffectGain, SetEffectGainAndDirection and SetConditionCoefficient add DIEP_NODOWNLOAD.
The per-device copy of quickForceUpdate (see above), read as m_unk0x00666ec8 by the effect setters.
Macro for InputFeedbackState::quickUpdate.
Type of g_forceFeedbackSlots, one per player: the forces sent to its device.

ForceFeedback_ApplyStoredForces compares each with field_0xc..0x14 and sends the change: effect 0 (spring), 1 (damper), 2 (constant force), the order StageTiming_InitForceFeedbackSlots creates them in; ForceFeedback_CacheAppliedForces copies them back.
Written by ForceFeedback_ComputeConditionCoefficients (spring, damper) and ForceFeedback_ComputeSteeringForce (constant, sent with SetEffectGainAndDirection).
ControllerData::textureForce; ForceFeedback_ComputeSteeringForce scales the force by it.
ControllerData::effectsForce; ForceFeedback_ComputeConditionCoefficients scales spring and damper by it.
ForceFeedback_ComputeRoadNoise: rand() with alternating sign, scaled by the corners' surface roughness times speed plus field_0x28; added to the steering force.
Set from the longitudinal part of an impact (FixedPoint.cpp), faded by ForceFeedback_FadeImpulseForces, added to or subtracted from the steering force by field_0x30.
Set from the length of an impact, faded, added to the road noise amplitude.
Device record of the player (Input_GetControllerSlotMapping), < 0 without force feedback; passed to every CInput effect call.
Set when the impact's longitudinal part is negative; the kick is then added instead of subtracted.
ForceFeedback_ActivateIdleSlots / DeactivateSlots; ForceFeedback_UpdatePlayerSlot computes the forces only while set.
ForceFeedback_UpdatePlayerSlot copies cornerOnGround[0..1] (the front wheels, whose cornerAxis the steering force uses), 0 off the stage.
ForceFeedback_ComputeAxleRumble: the average of the two axles' rumble; ForceFeedback_ComputeConditionCoefficients builds spring and damper from it.
Menu_Update plays it when the cursor moves; Menu_PlaySoundId(0).
Played on entering a submenu (Menu_Update, Menu_SetNextAction); Menu_PlaySoundId(1).
Played when Menu_Update goes back; Menu_PlaySoundId(2).
Menu_PlaySoundId(3): an empty session name, an invalid character in a name.
Played when Menu_Update changes an item's value left or right; Menu_PlaySoundId(4).
